segments.sn45.49:1.2: “Sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ – aruṇuggaṃ;
segments.sn45.49:1.3: evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ – kalyāṇamittatā.
segments.sn45.49:1.4: Kalyāṇamittassetaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ – ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissati.
segments.sn45.49:1.5: Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti?
segments.sn45.49:1.6: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ…pe… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn45.49:1.7: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotī”ti.

lines: Sūriyapeyyāle aruṇuggaṃ viya kalyāṇamittattā, kalyāṇamittatāya ṭhatvā nibbattito savipassanaariyamaggo sūriyapātubhāvo viyāti evaṃ sabbattha attho veditabbo.
Puna kalyāṇamittatātiādīni sammādiṭṭhiādīnaṃ aññenapi ākārena bhāvadassanatthaṃ vuttāni.
Sabbāneva cetāni suttāni pāṭiyekkaṃ puggalajjhāsayavasena vuttānīti.
Yathā aruṇuggaṃ sūriyuggamanassa ekantikaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, evaṃ kalyāṇamittatā ariyamaggapātubhāvassāti sadisūpamā aruṇuggaṃ kalyāṇamittatāya.
Kalyāṇamittoti cettha ariyo, ariyamaggo vā daṭṭhabbo sūriyapātubhāvo viya tena vidhūpanīyandhakāravidhamanato.
